participant_id.Description: Unique participant identifier. The 53 participants of this dataset are those retained after the exclusion criteria applied to all analyses (accuracy, data integrity, bad electrodes of interest, artifact rejection); participants excluded on these criteria are not included in the dataset.

included_behavioral.Description: Participant included in the behavioral analyses (accuracy, d').

included_probe_locked_erp.Description: Participant included in the probe-locked ERP analyses (N2pc, N2, FN400).

included_stimulus_locked_erp.Description: Participant included in the stimulus-locked ERP analyses (N2pc, CDA, negative slow wave, alpha power).

exclusion_stimulus_locked_erp.Description: Reason for exclusion from the stimulus-locked ERP analyses.

Levels.HEOG: Residual horizontal eye movements: difference greater than 3.2 µV in the corrected HEOG channel (criterion applied to stimulus-locked ERPs only)
